messages.subject: A favor
messages.body:
MONONYM Support asked for a ticket number. I gave them 8C2F. They still can’t find the incident in the public archive.

The original message passed through relay-07. Can you retrieve it? I’d like something I can attach to the ticket.

— Mira

messages.subject: The missing notice
messages.body:
I checked my inbox again. There’s no notice 2917 here.

The relay record says postbox-03 is holding it. Could you recover it? I’d like to see who sent it.

— Mira
